items.name: Replica sets in MongoDB
items.explanation: A replica set is a group of MongoDB servers that keep the same data. One member is the primary and the others are secondaries. MongoDB scales a whole replica set by moving its servers to a bigger or smaller tier together.

assumedBy.quote: Most MongoDB Atlas replica sets have daily seasonality.

items.name: MSTL time-series decomposition
items.explanation: MSTL splits a series of measurements into a trend, several repeating seasonal parts such as daily and weekly cycles, and what is left over. MongoDB uses it to forecast a few hours of demand from several weeks of history.

assumedBy.quote: Our forecasting model, MSTL (multi-seasonal trend decomposition using LOESS)
